report.explanation: Current telemetry is internally contradictory: one gateway trace shows an ERROR call to order at 903ms, but gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001, p95 73ms, zero dependency timeouts, and logs show only 200/ok. No order-side telemetry exists to bound a downstream cause. Evidence is insufficient to name a root cause; handoff with required observations.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/metrics/logs for the same window to confirm or refute downstream latency or errors
Gateway error-rate and latency metrics at finer granularity to reconcile with the single ERROR trace
Error/exception logs from gateway and order covering the alert window
Dependency timeout and connection-pool metrics for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql
Redis latency/timeout metrics for inventory dependency
